# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 6 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QH (Cave 1), Col. 6 | **Condition:** Better preserved

---

**6:1** I thank You, O Lord, for You have sustained me with Your strength and Your holy spirit You have poured upon me.

**6:2** I shall not falter. And You have strengthened me before the assaults of wickedness.

**6:3** And in all their devastation You have not let me be shaken from Your covenant.

**6:4** You have set me as a mighty tower, as a high wall, and You have established my building upon rock.

**6:5** And everlasting foundations for my footing, and all my walls are a tested rampart that shall not be moved.

**6:6** And You, O my God, have appointed me for the weary as holy counsel, and You have established me in Your covenant.

**6:7** And my tongue is as one instructed by You. But there is no utterance for the spirit of destruction.

**6:8** And no reply for all the children of guilt, for lying lips shall be silenced.

**6:9** For all those who assail me in judgment, You shall condemn them, to distinguish through me the righteous from the wicked.

**6:10** For You know the intent behind every deed and discern every utterance of the tongue.

**6:11** And You have directed my heart by Your teaching and by Your truth, to guide my steps into paths of righteousness.

**6:12** That I may walk before You in the land of the living, along paths of glory and peace without end.

**6:13** Without ceasing, and it is known [...] and apart from Your will nothing comes to be.

**6:14** I have relied upon Your covenant-faithfulness and upon the abundance of Your mercies.

**6:15** For You atone for iniquity and purify man from guilt by Your righteousness.

**6:16** Not for the sake of man, but for the sake of Your glory You have done this.

**6:17** For You have created the righteous and the wicked [...] from the womb You have ordained them.

**6:18** For the appointed time of favor and the testimony of [...] You have prepared them from eternity.

**6:19** Before You created them You knew their deeds for ever and ever.

**6:20** And apart from Your will nothing is accomplished, and nothing is known apart from Your good-pleasure.

**6:21** You have fashioned every spirit and their [...] and the judgment of all their deeds You have ordained.

**6:22** You have stretched out the heavens for Your glory, and all their host You have appointed by Your good-pleasure.

**6:23** And the mighty spirits according to their ordinances, before they became Your holy angels.

**6:24** And the eternal spirits in their dominions, the luminaries for their courses, the stars for their paths.

**6:25** And all the storm-winds for their tasks, the lightning and thunder for their service.

**6:26** And the storehouses of the deep for their function, and the reservoirs of [...] for their [...]

**6:27** You have created the earth by Your might, the seas and the deeps.

**6:28** And [...] You have established by Your wisdom, and all that is in them You have appointed by Your good-pleasure.

**6:29** And the spirit of man that You have fashioned in the world for all the ages of eternity.

**6:30** And the everlasting generations to [...] at their appointed seasons.

**6:31** And You have apportioned their works throughout all their generations and judgment at its proper seasons.

**6:32** For all the ages of eternity [...] and You have decreed it for them by the wisdom of Your knowledge.

**6:33** And before they came into being You knew their deeds, and nothing is accomplished apart from Your will.

**6:34** And it is You who have established all knowledge, and everything that exists is by Your good-pleasure.

**6:35** And there is no other to withstand Your counsel, or to fathom all Your holy purpose.

**6:36** Or to gaze into the depths of Your mysteries, or to comprehend all Your wonders.

**6:37** Together with the strength of Your power, and who can endure Your glory?

---

*SOPHIA notes: Column 6 consensus draws heavily from LOGOS for balanced dignity. Key decisions: "sustained" (EMET, 6:1) for its warm connotation; "falter" (LOGOS, 6:2) for physical force; "mighty tower" (LOGOS, 6:4) for grandeur; "stretched out the heavens" (LOGOS, 6:22) as the established creation verb from Isaiah; "dominions" (EMET, 6:24) preserving the authority connotation. The deterministic theology is faithfully preserved without softening.*
